findings.message: A data-dependent transformation is fitted on rows that include the evaluation rows.

evidence.detail: the transformed data is split or cross-validated afterwards

suggested_fix.description: Split first and fit on the training rows only, or put the step in a Pipeline that is fitted inside each fold.

findings.message: Rows were pooled from several source files with several rows per file, and the file each row came from is not kept; a row-level split puts rows of the same file (recording, subject, session) on both sides, so the score does not measure performance on new files.

evidence.detail: source file (rows appended per file in a loop)

suggested_fix.description: Record the source file (or subject) of each row and split by it (GroupKFold / GroupShuffleSplit with groups=file).

details.reason: the nominated column is not row-aligned with the split data at run time
